title: AAPS stopped receiving BG data from BYODA
body:
version 3.1.0.3

Build1de236a602-2022.0
8.09-10:42

Full release
NS 14.0.6

System working fine for 2 weeks.

Suddenly today it stopped receiving any BG data from BYODA., but BYODA is working fine.

Instead of a BG reading it just displayed the old one with (180 mins ago after 3 hours), then after the reinstallation it just says n/a ??

Also, the app is crashing regularly - I think when it tries to receive a reading from BYODA.

Have tried reinstalling the app, including after clearing cache and all data.

Log files attached

As I said, this was working fine until today. We changed nothing.  It simply stopped receiving BG readings.

On this phone also, it workled flawlessly for a year on an earlier version. I only changed phone 2 weeks ago (for a bigger screen), the phone I was on before did the same thing - worked OK for a few weeks then just failed one day. I thought it was somethinhg to with too little RAM but now it has happened on the old phone I have rehabilitated, I don't think that had anything to do with it.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1667764675517.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/9946797/AndroidAPS_LOG_1667764675517.log.zip)

comments.body:
I have an update.  I reinstalled BYODA and that seemed to resolve it.  I then read that the problem was my NS version was too old, I have now updated it.

Is it possible that the NS version being too old could result in it working fine for a few weeks, then suddenly stopping working?

No.

AAPS works as a stand alone system on your phone.
NS is only needed for your reports and to finish the objectives.

Think that it was a phone problem. Next time try a restart of your phone first.
Thanks.  I did actually try rebooting the phone to no avail.  It was only reinstalling BYODA which solved it.

Which obiously begs the question of whether the issue was BYODA or AAPS.  The fault manifested only in AAPS but it was the reinstallation of BYODA which fixed it.

I have been in touch with the developer of BYODA via his Reddit page, but he cannot think of anything which could have caused this issue.
